title: Every painted texture takes the device’s anisotropy
summary: The site paints 178 of its textures on a canvas: signs, labels, floors, walls, screens. Most were left at the weakest anisotropy, so a painted floor seen at a slant went soft a few metres out however strong the graphics chip. 97 more now take the device’s, 16 on a desktop and 4 on a phone. Nothing to see in these software-rendered pictures; the difference shows on a real graphics chip.

measured.note: Painted textures through sharpen: 29 → 126 of 178. Total JS 11679 kB, entry 160 kB, unchanged.
